lifestyle changes do contribute to patient’s wellbeing.

the level of compliance is not associated with the level of wellbeing in HF patients.

there are no sociodemographic factors that would determine compliance with lifestyle changes.
patients with heart failure should be treated individually and their needs should be assessed.

patients’ compliance is a complex process, which is dependent on a number of factors.
it is not the lifestyle changes that improve the patients’ wellbeing but the improvement of their condition.
